title: The Almost Locker
author: Dominic Okafor
blurb: Theo Thornbury, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
